# Setup

Loads packages for token summaries, Bayesian Gompertz fits, and plots, and sets `knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)`. Defines `extract_negation_lag()` and `plot_negation_scope_onset()` for scope onset summaries.

```{r packages, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(brms)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggrepel)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r knitr_options}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
```

```{r negation_onset_helpers, include=FALSE}
extract_negation_lag <- function(
    model, language_name, word_name, category_name) {

  model_summary <- brms::fixef(model)

  if (!"lag_Intercept" %in% rownames(model_summary)) {
    stop("Cannot find lag_Intercept for ", language_name, ": ", word_name)
  }

  lag_summary <- model_summary["lag_Intercept", ]

  tibble(
    language = language_name,
    category = category_name,
    word = word_name,
    Estimate = unname(lag_summary["Estimate"]),
    Est.Error = unname(lag_summary["Est.Error"]),
    Q2.5 = unname(lag_summary["Q2.5"]),
    Q97.5 = unname(lag_summary["Q97.5"])
  )
}


plot_negation_scope_onset <- function(onset_data, category_name) {

  plot_title <- paste(
    unique(onset_data$language),
    category_name,
    "Negation"
  )

  plot_data <- onset_data %>%
    filter(category == category_name, is.finite(Estimate)) %>%
    mutate(word = forcats::fct_reorder(word, Estimate))

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0L) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        theme_void() +
        annotate(
          "text", x = 0, y = 0,
          label = "No fitted lag estimate available"
        ) +
        labs(title = plot_title)
    )
  }

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 6)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 72)) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Fitted lag (months)",
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12)
}
```
# Load Data

Loads `english_tokens_processed` from the processed Feather file and creates `english_data_dir` and `english_model_dir`. Defines `english_negation_words`, `english_negation_forms`, and `english_negation_colors`.

```{r processedTokens}
english_data_dir <- "../english/english_data/processed_data"
english_model_dir <- "../english/english_model/modeling"

dir.create(english_model_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(english_data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

english_tokens_processed <- read_feather(
  file.path(english_data_dir, "english_tokens_processed.feather")
)

english_negation_words <- c("no", "not") # Scope-model categories, with not pooling free not and n't.
english_negation_forms <- c("no", "not", "n't")
english_negation_colors <- c("no" = "#0072B2", "not" = "#D55E00")
```

# Calculate Relative Frequencies

Counts processed rows by `speaker` and `age` in `english_speaker_age_totals` and defines `english_make_cumulative_frequencies()`. Sets child ages 0–10 to zero and excludes later zero-occurrence months from individual negator rates.

```{r frequency_helpers, include=FALSE}
# Count all recorded tokens before applying word-specific exclusions.
english_observed_speaker_age_totals <- english_tokens_processed %>%
  count(speaker, age, name = "total")

# Add ages 0–10 for children and impose the template's early-age zeros.
english_speaker_age_totals <- bind_rows(
  english_observed_speaker_age_totals %>%
    filter(speaker == "child") %>%
    complete(age = 0:10, fill = list(speaker = "child", total = 0L)) %>%
    mutate(total = if_else(age <= 10, 0L, total)),
  english_observed_speaker_age_totals %>%
    filter(speaker == "parent")
) %>%
  arrange(speaker, age)

# Apply the same counting procedure with table-specific columns and coverage.
english_make_cumulative_frequencies <- function(group_column, group_values, table_type) {
  counts <- english_tokens_processed %>%
    count(.data[[group_column]], speaker, age, name = "freq")

  frequency_rows <- crossing(.group = group_values, english_speaker_age_totals) %>%
    rename(!!group_column := .group) %>%
    left_join(counts, by = c(group_column, "speaker", "age")) %>%
    mutate(
      freq = replace_na(freq, 0L),
      freq = if_else(speaker == "child" & age <= 10, 0L, freq),
      relfreq = if_else(total == 0, 0, freq / total)
    )

  if (table_type == "word") {
    frequency_rows <- frequency_rows %>%
      filter(freq > 0 | (speaker == "child" & age %in% 0:10))
  }

  frequency_rows <- frequency_rows %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(group_column, "speaker")))) %>%
    arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
      cum_total = cumsum(total),
      cumulative_relfreq = if_else(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  if (table_type == "overall") {
    return(frequency_rows %>%
      mutate(pct = relfreq * 100, cumulative_pct = cumulative_relfreq * 100) %>%
      select(all_of(group_column), speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, pct,
             cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_pct) %>%
      ungroup())
  }
  if (table_type == "word") {
    return(frequency_rows %>%
      mutate(ppt = relfreq * 1000, cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000) %>%
      select(all_of(group_column), speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
             cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq, cumulative_ppt) %>%
      ungroup())
  }
  if (table_type == "category") {
    return(frequency_rows %>%
      mutate(ppt = relfreq * 1000) %>%
      select(all_of(group_column), speaker, age, freq, total, relfreq, ppt,
             cum_freq, cum_total, cumulative_relfreq) %>%
      ungroup())
  }
  stop("Unknown frequency-table type.")
}
```

## Target Negator and Other Token Rates

Calculates monthly `pct` and cumulative `cumulative_pct` by `syncategory` in `english_syncategory_relfreq`. Saves the table for `Function` target negators and `nonfunction` retained tokens.

```{r syncategory_relfreq}
english_syncategory_relfreq <- english_make_cumulative_frequencies(
  "syncategory", c("Function", "nonfunction"), "overall"
)

saveRDS(english_syncategory_relfreq, file.path(english_data_dir, "english_syncategory_relfreq.RDS"))
```

## Individual Negator Rates

Calculates monthly `ppt` and cumulative `cumulative_ppt` by `word` in `english_functionword_relfreq`. Pools free `not` and `n't` under `negation_category == "not"` before counting.

```{r functionword_relfreq}
# Word curves use the counted categories: no = no/nope/nah, not = not/n't.
english_tokens_processed <- english_tokens_processed %>%
  mutate(word = coalesce(negation_category, "nonfunction"))

english_functionword_relfreq <- english_make_cumulative_frequencies(
  "word", c("no", "not", "nonfunction"), "word"
)

saveRDS(english_functionword_relfreq, file.path(english_data_dir, "english_functionword_relfreq.RDS"))
```

## Negation Category Rates

Calculates monthly `ppt` and cumulative `cumulative_relfreq` by `word_category` in `english_wordcategory_relfreq`. Saves the `Negation` and `nonfunction` category rates.

```{r wordcategory_relfreq}
english_wordcategory_relfreq <- english_make_cumulative_frequencies(
  "word_category", c("Negation", "nonfunction"), "category"
)

saveRDS(english_wordcategory_relfreq, file.path(english_data_dir, "english_wordcategory_relfreq.RDS"))
```

# Plot and Fit Growth Curves

Plots speaker-level negation rates and fits Bayesian Gompertz curves to child `pct` and `cumulative_ppt` trajectories. Produces fitted child data and lag summaries for onset comparisons.

## Overall Negation

Plots monthly `pct` from `english_syncategory_relfreq` by `speaker` and fits `english_negation_words_lagModel` to child values. Saves `english_negation_words_childdata` with `predictions` and displays the fitted curve.

```{r negation_words_plot}
english_negation_words_plot <- english_syncategory_relfreq %>%
  filter(syncategory == "Function") %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, pct)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ speaker) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Age (Months)") + ylab("Monthly Percent of Tokens") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 14))

english_negation_words_plot
```

```{r negation_words_growth_model, include=FALSE}
english_negation_words_lagModel <- brm(
  bf(
    pct ~ upperAsymptote *
      exp(-exp(((growthRate * exp(1)) / upperAsymptote) * (lag - age) + 1)),
    upperAsymptote ~ 1,
    growthRate ~ 1,
    lag ~ 1,
    nl = TRUE
  ),
  data = filter(english_syncategory_relfreq, syncategory == "Function", speaker == "child"),
  prior = c(
    prior(uniform(0, 100), nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = 100),
    prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
    prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
  ),
  # Reuse the existing cache after renaming the in-memory model object.
  file = file.path(english_model_dir, "english_function_word_lagModel"),
  file_refit = "on_change",
  iter = 10000,
  seed = 16
)
```

```{r negation_words_predictions}
english_negation_words_predictions <- as.data.frame(fitted(english_negation_words_lagModel))

english_negation_words_childdata <- filter(
  english_syncategory_relfreq, syncategory == "Function", speaker == "child"
)
english_negation_words_childdata$predictions <- english_negation_words_predictions[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(
  english_negation_words_childdata,
  file.path(english_data_dir, "english_negation_words_childdata.RDS")
)
```

```{r negation_words_prediction_plot}
english_negation_words_plot <-
  ggplot(english_negation_words_childdata, aes(x = age, y = pct)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = "Actual Data"), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predictions, color = "Fitted Values"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Legend",
    values = c("Actual Data" = "black", "Fitted Values" = "blue")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "Negation Words", x = "Child Age (Month)", y = "Monthly Percent of Tokens") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  )

english_negation_words_plot
```

## Individual Negators

Plots `cumulative_ppt` for `no` and `not` by `speaker` and fits child Gompertz curves. Saves fitted child tables and model objects for the word onset comparison.

### no

Plots `cumulative_ppt` for `no` and fits `english_no_lagModel` to child data. Saves `english_no_childdata` with `predictions` and records the model lag summary.

```{r no_plot, echo=FALSE}
english_functionword_relfreq %>%
  filter(word == "no") %>%
  ggplot(aes(age, cumulative_ppt)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_grid(. ~ speaker) +
  theme_bw() +
  ggtitle("no") +
  xlab("Age (Months)") + ylab("Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens")
```

```{r no_growth_model, include=FALSE}
english_no_modeldata <- filter(english_functionword_relfreq, word == "no", speaker == "child")
if (!any(english_no_modeldata$cumulative_ppt > 0)) {
  stop("No nonzero child 'no' observations are available for the word model.")
}
english_no_asymptote <- max(5, ceiling(max(english_no_modeldata$cumulative_ppt) * 2))

english_no_lagModel <- brm(
  bf(
    cumulative_ppt ~ upperAsymptote *
      exp(-exp(((growthRate * exp(1)) / upperAsymptote) * (lag - age) + 1)),
    upperAsymptote ~ 1,
    growthRate ~ 1,
    lag ~ 1,
    nl = TRUE
  ),
  data = english_no_modeldata,
  prior = c(
    set_prior(
      sprintf("uniform(0, %s)", english_no_asymptote),
      nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = english_no_asymptote
    ),
    prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
    prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
  ),
  file = file.path(english_model_dir, "english_no_lagModel"),
  file_refit = "on_change",
  iter = 10000,
  seed = 16
)
```

```{r no_predictions}
english_no_predictions <- as.data.frame(fitted(english_no_lagModel))

english_no_childdata <- filter(english_functionword_relfreq, word == "no", speaker == "child")
english_no_childdata$predictions <- english_no_predictions[, "Estimate"]

saveRDS(english_no_childdata, file.path(english_data_dir, "english_no_childdata.RDS"))
```

```{r no_age_of_production}
  Est.Error = round(unname(english_no_lag["Est.Error"]), 1),
  Q2.5 = round(unname(english_no_lag["Q2.5"]), 1),

)
```

## Sentential and Discourse Negation

Calculates scope-specific `cumulative_ppt` and fits child Gompertz curves by `negation_scope` and `negation_category`. Saves fitted child tables and scope onset summaries.

### Calculate Scope Rates

Calculates `cumulative_ppt` by `negation_scope` and `negation_category` from `english_tokens_processed` against `english_child_age_totals`. Saves `english_negation_scope_relfreq`.

```{r negation_scope_data, include=FALSE}
english_child_age_totals <- english_speaker_age_totals %>%
  filter(speaker == "child") %>%
  select(age, total)

english_negation_scope_relfreq <- english_tokens_processed %>%
  filter(speaker == "child", !is.na(negation_category),
         negation_scope %in% c("sentential", "discourse")) %>%
  count(negation_scope, negation_category, age, name = "freq") %>%
  complete(nesting(negation_scope, negation_category), age = 0:10,
           fill = list(freq = 0L)) %>%
  left_join(english_child_age_totals, by = "age") %>%
  mutate(
    speaker = "child",
    total = replace_na(total, 0L),
    freq = if_else(age <= 10, 0L, freq),
    relfreq = if_else(total == 0, 0, freq / total),
    ppt = relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  filter(freq > 0 | age %in% 0:10) %>%
  group_by(negation_scope, negation_category) %>%
  arrange(age, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    cum_freq = cumsum(freq),
    cum_total = cumsum(total),
    cumulative_relfreq = if_else(cum_total == 0, 0, cum_freq / cum_total),
    cumulative_ppt = cumulative_relfreq * 1000
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

saveRDS(english_negation_scope_relfreq,
        file.path(english_data_dir, "english_negation_scope_relfreq.RDS"))

# Token counts behind each curve (no-sentential = determiner no).
english_negation_scope_relfreq %>%
  group_by(negation_scope, negation_category) %>%
  summarise(n_tokens = sum(freq), n_months = sum(freq > 0), .groups = "drop")
```

### Fit Scope Curves

Fits Gompertz curves to scope series with positive `cumulative_ppt` and saves `english_sentential_negation_childdata` and `english_discourse_negation_childdata` with `predictions`.

```{r negation_scope_curve_data, include=FALSE}
english_scope_series <- english_negation_scope_relfreq %>%
  group_by(negation_scope, negation_category) %>%
  filter(any(cumulative_ppt > 0)) %>%
  group_split()

english_scope_models <- list()
english_scope_childdata <- list()

for (d in english_scope_series) {
  d <- arrange(d, age)
  key <- paste(d$negation_category[1], d$negation_scope[1], sep = "_")
  asymptote <- max(5, ceiling(max(d$cumulative_ppt) * 2))

  model <- brm(
    bf(cumulative_ppt ~ upperAsymptote *
         exp(-exp(((growthRate * exp(1)) / upperAsymptote) * (lag - age) + 1)),
       upperAsymptote ~ 1, growthRate ~ 1, lag ~ 1, nl = TRUE),
    data = d,
    prior = c(
      set_prior(sprintf("uniform(0, %s)", asymptote),
                nlpar = "upperAsymptote", lb = 0, ub = asymptote),
      prior(uniform(0, 10), nlpar = "growthRate", lb = 0, ub = 10),
      prior(uniform(10, 72), nlpar = "lag", lb = 10, ub = 72)
    ),
    file = file.path(english_model_dir, paste0("english_", key, "_lagModel")),
    file_refit = "on_change",
    iter = 10000,
    seed = 16
  )

  d$predictions <- fitted(model, newdata = d)[, "Estimate"]
  english_scope_models[[key]] <- model
  english_scope_childdata[[key]] <- d
}

english_scope_childdata_all <- bind_rows(english_scope_childdata)
english_sentential_negation_childdata <- filter(english_scope_childdata_all, negation_scope == "sentential")
english_discourse_negation_childdata  <- filter(english_scope_childdata_all, negation_scope == "discourse")

saveRDS(english_sentential_negation_childdata,
        file.path(english_data_dir, "english_sentential_negation_childdata.RDS"))
saveRDS(english_discourse_negation_childdata,
        file.path(english_data_dir, "english_discourse_negation_childdata.RDS"))

english_plot_child_negation <- function(plot_data, plot_title) {
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = age, y = cumulative_ppt)) +
    geom_point(color = "black", size = 2) +
    geom_line(aes(y = predictions), color = "blue", linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
    facet_wrap(~ negation_category, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, 12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Child Age (Months)",
         y = "Cumulative Occurrences per 1,000 Tokens") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}
```

### Estimate and Plot Scope Onsets

Extracts `lag_Intercept` and 95% credible intervals from `english_scope_models` into `english_negation_scope_age_of_production`. Saves and displays separate sentential and discourse onset plots.

```{r scope_age_of_production}
english_negation_scope_age_of_production <- purrr::imap_dfr(english_scope_models, function(model, key) {
  parts <- str_split_fixed(key, "_", 2)
  extract_negation_lag(model, "English", word_name = parts[, 1],
                       category_name = str_to_title(parts[, 2]))
})

saveRDS(english_negation_scope_age_of_production,
        file.path(english_data_dir, "english_negation_scope_age_of_production.RDS"))

english_sentential_negation_onset_plot <-
  plot_negation_scope_onset(english_negation_scope_age_of_production, "Sentential")
english_discourse_negation_onset_plot <-
  plot_negation_scope_onset(english_negation_scope_age_of_production, "Discourse")

for (nm in c("sentential", "discourse")) {
  p <- get(paste0("english_", nm, "_negation_onset_plot"))
  saveRDS(p, file.path(english_data_dir, paste0("english_", nm, "_negation_onset_plot.RDS")))
}

english_negation_scope_age_of_production
english_sentential_negation_onset_plot
english_discourse_negation_onset_plot
```

```{r sentential_graph}
english_sentential_negation_child_plot <- english_plot_child_negation(

)
```

# Word Onset Estimates

Combines `english_no_age_of_production` and `english_not_age_of_production` into `english_age_of_production` and plots lag estimates with 95% credible intervals. Interprets these values as fitted lag parameters rather than observed first-production ages.

```{r age_of_production_build}
english_age_of_production <- bind_rows(
  english_no_age_of_production,
  english_not_age_of_production
)

english_age_of_production
```

```{r age_of_production_plot}
english_negation_onsetage_plot <- english_age_of_production %>%
  mutate(word = fct_reorder(word, Estimate)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = word)) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(xmin = Q2.5, xmax = Q97.5)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 72, by = 3)) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (Months)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

english_negation_onsetage_plot
```
